stats.source: GOB 310 loaded grant 1083; the capture-qualified zero grant is pinned in research/protocol/loaded-grant-membership.json. The sole stat component is 1% Viral Damage Bonus (1031).
stats.runtime: AbilityPassives.SetLoaded expands grant membership; AbilityGrantRegistration reconciles the native readiness, reload and unload records. AbilityStats.ScaleTypedAbilityDamage consumes the linked bonus on a damaging cast.
stats.test: AbilityScaledBuffTests.HackerParentsRegisterGrantsAndRemoveOnlyTheirContribution exercises new membership, idempotent reload and matching removal. The same test asserts bonus-influenced damage before unload and the prior value afterward.

periodic.source: GOB 332 stores a 2.5 s interval and 50 s duration. tempmods.py HOT rounds the scheduled amount.
periodic.runtime: AbilitySupport.Land installs an active HOT and TimedEffects.RunDue dispatches pre-expiry ticks through PlayerEffects.Ticked and the normal health updater.
periodic.test: AbilityParityTests.EmergencyRepairsTwoUsesTheSelectedTargetStoredTotalAndExpiresBeforeTwentiethTick asserts nineteen +4 ticks and removal. The stock overflow callback remains a distinct script check.

stats.runtime: TimedEffects.Apply publishes both penalties and AbilityStats.Defense consumes them.

healing.source: GOB 371 uses team selector 9, radius 7 m, cast time 4 s, four-second own and family 685 reuse, and fixed typed healing 20.
healing.runtime: AbilitySupport.Targets uses same-district live team membership and AbilityRadius.Metres. AbilityHealing.Amount reads the fixed total and healer influence; AbilitySupport.Land heals each admitted recipient.
healing.test: The ability-parity-hacker-sweep bootstrap replays full activation frames, verifies cast and both reuse records, and checks exact fresh self/recipient HP deltas under the +10% source build. It checks a teammate at 4 m, another at 9.25 m and an unrelated player at 3 m, with the loaded Resist Damage passive expanding the radii to 8.68 m and 9.92 m.

stats.source: GOB 373 has one self-only, 300-second stat 522 modifier, with character-level function 3 and scale 1.3.
stats.runtime: AbilitySupport.Targets confines the apply to the caster. AbilityScaledBuffs resolves the applied value and AbilityStats.Attack consumes it; AbilityBuffs.Remove removes the paired record and contribution.
stats.test: AbilityScaledBuffTests.HackerAccuracyBuffUsesCasterLevelAndConsumedAttackStats asserts +25 at 20, +64 at 50, exact melee consumption and baseline restoration. ability-parity-hacker-sweep asserts the paired on/off wire records.
